run.android: a Samsung Galaxy A55 with Android 17
run.app: the code of commit 968a86a7 on both phones: on the iPhone a Release build, the kind TestFlight ships, and for the ae-life-… rows a Debug build, which the lifecycle test needs; on Android a debug APK, for most rows of the build just before 968a86a7, which differs only in how a test connection that fails while traffic still comes back counts (ae-tor-only, ae-both-upload, the ae-life-… and the ae-guide-… rows ran on 968a86a7 itself)
